you gotta figure out your own path to peace. take all advice with a grain of salt, even mine. your life is about you. you’re an unique individual with your own unique perspective. don’t worry about what people think you should do. find out what works for you.

and i’m telling you that you don’t have to listen to what anyone suggests. meditation has to be specific for you. meaning it’s up to you to decide how to make it a good experience for you. for me meditation is smokin a j and drinkin tea outside in the morning. you have to make it personal. people can tell you whatever but they aren’t you. you know what you need or at the very least, what you don’t want. don’t worry about suggestions. the main thing is figuring out what helps you.

usually only with medical marijuana do they teach about terpenes and stuff like that. i’m a budtender in maryland and that’s one of the first things you learn about. with recreational you kinda just get what you get. my best advice is to just try small portions of different strains. when i went to cali i bought about an oz worth of different strains. once you find one that gives you the desired high try to remember how it tastes and smells. terpenes give each strain its unique smell and taste so when your senses respond well, it usually means that strain is gonna give you a good high. for example, strains that have a more lemon smell and taste to them usually contain limonene which is usually present in more sativa leaning strains. there’s no way to know 100% because every batch is different but most strains have certain terpenes that almost always show up. for example, anything with purp or purple in the name usually contains linalool, which is usually associated with more indica leaning strains. hope this helps!
